title: COALESCE returns the first argument that is not BLANK

source.quote: Returns 10 , which is the first expression that does not evaluate to BLANK
source.supports: the example COALESCE ( BLANK (), 10, DATE ( 2008, 3, 3 ) ) returns 10

source.quote: COALESCE returns the first argument that is not BLANK

derivation: The first argument is BLANK, the second is 10: the result is 10. Both arguments that have a type are integers, so the result is an integer.
notes: The Microsoft example has a date as third argument. It is left out here because DAX Guide says the result type can change with the types of the arguments.
